page.overview:
Who is Bernado de Noli?

Bernado de Noli was the court advisor in Miragliano. In his notes reported on the campaign of his prince Lorenzo of Miragliano, which he led together with the mercenary armies of the allied city-states of Tilea against Remas. He also noted The Fall of Miragliano in 2522 IC, which he seen directly as a witness. In his notes, he specifically praised the bravery of Lorenzo's son, Prince Giuliano of Miragliano, whom he, like his father, stood by as a consultant. When the doom of the city was sealed, he hid the diary-shaped records under a loose brick in the fireplace in a room of the Miragliano citadel.

Like Crown Prince Giuliano, his master's son, he was kidnapped by the Skaven with the other survivors and murdered on the edge of the Zombie Swamps, where the returning Prince Lorenzo found his head on a stake while chasing the Skaven horde in the hope of saving his son and only heir.
